headline: YPF and Vista Report Record Production and Strong Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: YPF reported the second-best EBITDA in its history for the third quarter and record profitability of US$2,503 million, driven by higher oil prices. Vista also recorded an operating profit of US$841 million, exporting 70% of its Vaca Muerta crude.
why: YPF and Vista are leading Argentine oil and gas producers operating in the Vaca Muerta shale formation, making their financial results key indicators of the country's energy sector viability.

impacts.name: YPF SA
impacts.why: Record operational earnings and higher realized oil prices boosted the company's financial standing.

why_moved: Surging international oil prices combined with record domestic shale production significantly expanded profit margins for Argentine energy operators.
